title: Team knowledge cards
productBrief: A small team wants a shared workspace for knowledge cards. Each card has a stable identity, a human-readable title, and may link to other cards even when titles change.
expectedStructuralObservations: Cards need stable IDs separate from mutable titles.
Links should target card identity rather than display text.
scriptedUserNotes: I care about renaming cards without breaking links.
Two cards can have similar titles, so titles cannot be the only reference.

deferredExpectations.graph: Later graph fixtures should produce identity/reference nodes and link invariants.
deferredExpectations.coherence: Later coherence checks should flag title-anchored references as weak evidence.
